          pattern: "(?s).*\\S.*"
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City

          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          pattern: "(?s).*\\S.*"
          example: Madison

          title: Telephone number
          description: >-
            The telephone number of the pet owner. On create/update it is
            normalized to E.164 form: spaces, dashes and brackets are stripped; a
            leading '+' and country code are kept when present, otherwise country
            code '+61' is assumed and a single leading '0' is dropped from the
            national digits. The result must have 8 to 15 digits after the '+', and
            that E.164 string is the stored/returned value (e.g. '0412 345 678'

          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20

              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true

              title: Initials
              description: >-
                The owner's initials as the upper-cased first letters of the first

              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: >-
                The owner's customer code, formatted '<CITY3>-<LAST3>-<NNNN>' where
                CITY3 is the upper-cased first three letters of the city, LAST3 the
                upper-cased first three letters of the last name and NNNN is a
                per-city 4-digit zero-padded sequence equal to one more than the
                number of owners already in that city at the time the owner was
                created.
              type: string
              example: 'LON-SMI-0007'
              readOnly: true

              title: Membership number
              description: >-
                The owner's membership number, formatted '<customerCode>-M<YY>'

              type: string

              description: >-
